changelog:
The community QA page now reads as a story: three beats - spotted in real use, reproduced deliberately, verified independently - each with its own icon, instead of one paragraph.
The page assembles itself once when opened, and that reveal is draw-time only: a device with reduced motion, animations disabled or a cancelled animation shows the complete page, never a half-transparent one.
The credits caveat stands on its own quiet strip, the disclosure keeps its exact original behaviour, and nothing on the page writes a single preference.
message: Dev build v860 - The community QA page reads like a story and assembles itself
